_help: Copy to kit/specs/<id>.json and edit. id = folder name. Voice phrases: one idea each, numbers as words (put the digits in cap), phrases ending in ? get the rising question tone automatically. Slides: p = phrase index, hw = word index where each headline line is revealed, xw = word indexes where the element's cues fire (see kit/ELEMENTS.md). Refs: 3 | '3+0.1' | 'end' | 'end-0.12' | [phraseIndex, word, offset].

phrases.t: Does it sound like a robot?
No. It writes in your voice.
